world.yaw: positive character rotation about +Y; nose moves to image right

camera.target: source humanoid head joint plus target_offset_m

render.alpha: opaque structure outputs; source identity uses straight RGBA
render.data_output: no color conversion or tone mapping
render.depth: camera view distance, normalized linearly between near and far; near is white; RGB8 diagnostic only
render.normal: camera-space, xyz mapped from [-1,1] to [0,1]; RGB8 diagnostic
render.part_id: source mesh Body=red, Face=green, Hair=blue; not semantic decomposition ground truth

authority.aka_psd: SOURCE_TRUTH for PSD default composition only; not certified INX runtime default parity
authority.vrm: INFERRED_STRUCTURE relative to Aka; exact sample geometry relative to VRM source
